Proper testing and validation are critical to ensure the new code meets performance and reliability standards. Collaboration between developers, AI experts, and stakeholders is vital for a smooth transition. By following these steps, organizations can effectively leverage AI to modernize their codebases.

医疗组织如何使用Claude Tag  
Claude Tag是一种标签管理系统，医疗组织利用它对病历、影像和医疗数据进行分类和追踪。通过该系统，医疗机构可高效整合信息，提升数据管理效率。此外，Claude Tag支持数据共享和权限控制，确保患者隐私安全。该工具的应用有助于优化诊疗流程，减少信息混乱，促进医疗资源合理分配。
summaries.en: Healthcare organizations utilize Claude Tag to streamline data management and improve patient care. The tool enhances efficiency by organizing medical records, facilitating communication among staff, and ensuring compliance with regulations. It supports secure data sharing, reduces manual errors, and enables quick access to critical patient information. By integrating Claude Tag, hospitals and clinics optimize workflows, enhance decision-making, and maintain high standards of service. The system also aids in tracking patient outcomes and optimizing resource allocation. Overall, Claude Tag serves as a vital solution for modern healthcare settings.

医疗组织如何使用Claude Tag  
Claude Tag是一种标签管理系统，医疗组织利用它对病历、影像和医疗数据进行分类和追踪。通过该系统，医疗机构可高效整合信息，提升数据管理效率。此外，Claude Tag支持数据共享和权限控制，确保患者隐私安全。该工具的应用有助于优化诊疗流程，减少信息混乱，促进医疗资源合理分配。

items.title: Agentic coding is straining CI. Here’s how we scaled test impact analysis at Anthropic
items.content: Agentic coding is straining CI. Here’s how we scaled test impact analysis at Anthropic
items.contentSnippet: Agentic coding is straining CI. Here’s how we scaled test impact analysis at Anthropic

summaries.zh: 自动化编码给持续集成（CI）带来压力。Anthropic通过扩展测试影响分析来解决这个问题。具体方法包括优化分析工具和流程，以更高效地评估代码变更的影响范围，从而减轻CI负担。此举提高了测试覆盖率和准确性，确保了代码质量。
summaries.en: Agentic coding is increasing pressure on Continuous Integration (CI) systems. Anthropic addressed this by scaling test impact analysis to predict which tests need re-running after changes. The approach involves leveraging code structure and change scope to minimize redundant test executions, improving CI efficiency. This method ensures faster feedback loops while maintaining test coverage. The solution is designed to handle the growing complexity of agentic development workflows.
